title: WikiLeaks email: Hillary Clinton asks about Gilgamesh's tomb
summary: Tim Alberino tells of WikiLeaks email: Hillary Clinton asks about Gilgamesh's tomb, about 2016 at Iraq, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Remember there was allegedly an email that was a correspondence with Hillary Clinton where she was inquiring about the resurrection tomb and body of Gilgamesh.

plain: Tim Alberino, a researcher, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about emails released in 2016 by WikiLeaks, a website that publishes leaked documents. He says there was allegedly an email in which the American politician Hillary Clinton asked about the tomb and body of Gilgamesh, a king from ancient legend, in Iraq, which would mean top officials took that ancient story seriously.
